look: Painted storybook illustration of a place in a small medieval fantasy world, soft gouache with visible brush texture, muted natural colours, soft light and long soft shadows, hand-painted, one single full-bleed image with no fold, frame or border, no text, lettering, signature or watermark anywhere, wide landscape composition
keepOut: photorealism, 3d render, anime, neon colours, modern objects

acts.act1: Warm late-day light, earthy greens and straw golds, homely and lived-in
acts.act2: Clear daylight and richer colour, deep greens, warm reds and creams, a faint grey haze at the edges
acts.act3: Cooler, wilder light, colours a little drained, as if a sickness were creeping into the land
acts.act4: Cold, dim light, violet and grey shadows, colours drained almost to stone, a hush of dread
